test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘BELO’ is coded as ‘271217’ and ‘IGJA’ is coded as ‘117103’. How will ‘DUXE’ be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8917e7e4a037fb946fafa0b16de664d6f0ce32ab76e5c2c9b848dc1f771a7f81.png] 

The logic followed here is: **Vowel + 2 and Consonants are the same.**

‘BELO’ is coded as ‘271217’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02112d36119829854d1ce6d055c35d036858c0529c1e67155246bea75ba81706.png] 

‘IGJA’ is coded as ‘117103’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/162dd88ee97d0a0e6b0cad56ad088e08d3ae0472646dc3bb9c28ba771843e243.png] 

Similarly, ‘**DUXE**’ be coded:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ff96eea6a30327648acfb64a22c3605c0a1d44bff32689829a18521a019bae8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**423247**".
